As a Full Stack Software Engineer specializing in Java, you will play a key role in the design, development, testing, and deployment of enterprise\-grade applications. You will work closely with product managers, UX designers, and fellow engineers to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions. This role requires strong expertise in Java\-based back\-end frameworks (such as Spring Boot) as well as modern front\-end technologies (such as React). Beyond traditional full\-stack development, you will help drive the integration of **Agentic AI into the SDLC** — building or leveraging AI agents that assist with code generation, testing, code review, documentation, and CI/CD automation. You will work with emerging frameworks such as **MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers** and **Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK)** (or equivalent agent orchestration frameworks) to connect LLM\-based agents to internal tools, APIs, and data sources securely. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working across the full technology stack, has an appetite for AI\-augmented engineering practices, and wants to make a tangible impact on both product development and internal developer productivity.


* Design, develop, and maintain full\-stack web applications using Java (Spring Boot/Spring MVC) and modern JavaScript frameworks (React/Angular)
* **Design, build, and maintain Micro Frontend (MFE) architecture** — including module federation, independent deployment pipelines, and shared component/design systems across multiple teams
* **Integrate and orchestrate multiple micro frontends** into a cohesive shell/host application, ensuring consistent UX, routing, and state management across modules
* Build and consume RESTful APIs and microservices
* Write clean, efficient, well\-tested, and maintainable code
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (Product, UX, QA, DevOps) in an Agile/Scrum environment
* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical design decisions, including frontend decomposition strategy (MFE boundaries, ownership models)
* Perform code reviews and mentor junior engineers
* Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance (including cross\-MFE performance and bundle size optimization)
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and independent deployment of micro frontends
* Ensure application security, scalability, and reliability
* Work with relational databases for data modeling and query optimization
* Deploy and manage applications in GCP cloud environments
* **Design and implement Agentic AI workflows within the SDLC** — e.g., AI agents for automated code review, test generation, ticket triage, and documentation
* **Build, configure, and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers** to expose internal APIs, databases, and tools securely to LLM/agent\-based systems
* **Develop and orchestrate AI agents using ADK (Agent Development Kit)** or comparable agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel) for multi\-step, tool\-using workflows
* Integrate agentic AI capabilities into existing CI/CD pipelines to accelerate development, testing, and release cycles
* Evaluate, prototype, and pilot emerging agentic AI tools/frameworks and recommend adoption where they improve engineering velocity or code quality
* Ensure governance, security, and observability practices are applied to AI agent integrations (e.g., permissions, auditability, guardrails)
* Stay current with emerging technologies and recommend improvements
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* 2\+ years of professional experience in full stack software development
* Strong proficiency in **Java** and frameworks such as **Spring Boot / Spring MVC / Hibernate**
* Solid experience with front\-end technologies: **JavaScript/TypeScript**, and a modern framework (**React)**
* Experience building and consuming **RESTful APIs / microservices**
* Proficiency with relational databases (**PostgreSQL**)
* Experience with version control (**Git**) and CI/CD tools ( **GitHub Actions**)
* Familiarity with **Micro Frontend (MFE) concepts** (e.g., Webpack Module Federation, Single\-SPA, Nx monorepo, or native federation) and modular UI design
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work both independently and in a team
* Hands\-on exposure to **LLM\-based tools or agentic AI concepts** (e.g., using AI coding assistants, prompt engineering, or building simple agent workflows)

Good to Have:


* Experience with GCPcloud platforms
* Knowledge of containerization tools
* Exposure to automated testing frameworks
* Understanding of security best practices (OAuth2, JWT)
* Prior experience in automotive, manufacturing, or enterprise\-scale systems
* Relevant certifications (Java, GCP certifications)

* Hands\-on experience designing AI agents, tool chains, and agent frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, etc.).

jobs.description:
**About the Projects:** We are building LLM evaluation and training datasets to train LLM to work on realistic software engineering problems. One of our approaches, in this project, is to build verifiable SWE tasks based on public repository histories in a synthetic approach with human\-in\-the\-loop; while expanding the dataset coverage to different types of tasks in terms of programming language, difficulty level, and etc. **About the Role:** We are looking for experienced software engineers (tech lead level) who are familiar with high\-quality public GitHub repositories and can contribute to this project. This role involves hands\-on software engineering work, including development environment automation, issue triaging, and evaluating test coverage and quality. **Why Join Us?**
Turing is one of the world’s fastest\-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. You’ll be at the forefront of evaluating how LLMs interact with real code, influencing the future of AI\-assisted software development. This is a unique opportunity to blend practical software engineering with AI research. **What does day\-to\-day look like:*** Analyze and triage GitHub issues across trending open\-source libraries.
* Set up and configure code repositories, including Dockerization and environment setup.
* Evaluating unit test coverage and quality.
* Modify and run codebases locally to assess LLM performance in bug\-fixing scenarios.
* Collaborate with researchers to design and identify repositories and issues that are challenging for LLMs.
* Opportunities to lead a team of junior engineers to collaborate on projects.

 **Required Skills:*** Minimum 3\+ years of overall experience.
* Strong experience with at least one of the following languages: Ruby.
* Proficiency with Git, Docker, and basic software pipeline setup.
* Ability to understand and navigate complex codebases.
* Comfortable running, modifying, and testing real\-world projects locally.
* Experience contributing to or evaluating open\-source projects is a plus.

 **Nice to Have:*** Previous participation in LLM research or evaluation projects.
* Experience building or testing developer tools or automation agents.
* Perks of Freelancing With Turing:
	+ Work in a fully remote environment.
	+ Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

 **Offer Details:*** **Commitments Required:** At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST. (We have 3 options of time commitment: 20 hrs/week, 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week).
* **Employment type:** Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave).

  

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

jobs.title: AI Engineer, Agentic Systems (Quality Engineering)
jobs.description:
Bangalore, Karnātaka, India IT Ref ID: JR\-022096  

**Our Mission**


At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.


**Who We Are**


In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!


We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
**Job Summary**


As a Staff Software Engineer in IT Quality Engineering Automation, you will be the technical anchor and visionary for our automated testing and next\-generation SDLC ecosystem, operating directly from our Bangalore office. At Palo Alto Networks, we are transitioning from traditional QA to an **AI\-First engineering culture**.

  

  

We are looking for an early\-in\-career AI Engineer to build and ship custom Agentic AI. Applications across an Enterprise IT landscape spanning Salesforce, SAP, custom. Licensing and Entitlement management applications, and AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning and ITSM platforms. You will work with modern generative AI — LLM orchestration, autonomous agent loops, tool calling and RAG — against real enterprise infrastructure, building agents that carry out multi\-step business workflows, act on data across these systems through their APIs, and hand back to a human when they should.

  

  

At Palo Alto Networks we are moving towards an AI\-First engineering culture, and you will not be starting from a blank page. You will build on our own internal AI platform tools for test generation, automation scripting, execution and quality reporting.

  

  

### **Agentic Systems \& Enterprise Integration**


* **Build agentic features:** Develop and maintain agent workflows using LangGraph, ADK, LangChain, AutoGen or CrewAI, including planner/executor loops, state handling and failure recovery.
* **Enable cross\-system integration and tool calling:** Connect agents across enterprise applications, including: **Salesforce:** REST/SOAP APIs, Webhooks, Platform Events, Apex Invocable Methods, SOQL and Flows. **SAP:** OData/BAPI services and business\-object events. **Custom applications:** Licensing, Entitlement, AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning and ITSM through REST APIs, webhooks and message queues.
* **Build context grounding and RAG pipelines:** Use vector stores such as pgvector, Pinecone and Weaviate to provide LLMs with accurate, current enterprise context.
* **Define tools and schemas:** Create well\-specified tool definitions and JSON function schemas, including MCP tools, to support deterministic tool calls and traceability back to Jira.

### **Agent Quality, Safety \& Observability**


* **Build evaluation suites:** Develop and run golden\-set evaluations to validate improvements to agents and prompts before release.
* **Implement guardrails and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows:** Establish safety controls, rate limiting, fallbacks and clear approval handoffs, especially when agents write to systems of record.
* **Enable observability:** Instrument agents with tracing and metrics covering execution paths, latency, context usage and token costs, and use findings to improve performance.
* **responsible AI practices:** Follow company policies on intellectual property and data privacy, keep secrets in managed stores and require explicit opt\-in for steps that send content to external services.

### **Collaboration \& Growth**


* **Collaborate across functions:** Partner with Salesforce, SAP and platform architects, QE leads, product managers and security teams to deliver reliable AI features that meet business, quality and enterprise compliance requirements.
* **Learn the enterprise landscape:** Build an understanding of transaction flows from AI Custom Quoting and order capture through licensing, entitlement, provisioning and service management. Prior knowledge is not required, but proactive learning is expected.

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
**About Turing**
================


Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high\-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest\-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end\-to\-end agentic AI systems inside mission\-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real\-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com.

  

**Role:** Forward\-Deployed AI Engineer — Enterprise AI
  

**Location:** Hyderabad, India
  

**Experience Level:** 8\+ years
  

**Work Model:** Hybrid, 3 days per week in office
  

**Employment Type:** Full Time


**Why Join Enterprise AI?**
---------------------------


Enterprise AI is a distinct business unit within Turing, operating with the speed, focus, and ownership of a rapidly scaling startup. When it comes to applied AI in the workplace, you’ll define the frontier by building beyond it.


You’ll join the initial team of Forward\-Deployed Engineers, shaping how we work while solving enterprise\-grade problems for the world’s leading enterprises. As a Forward\-Deployed AI Engineer, you’ll own outcomes end to end—from identifying high\-value customer problems and shaping architecture to building production systems and working directly with senior client leaders.


You’ll develop generative AI solutions in the real world, driving measurable impact and return on investment within large institutions. Enterprise AI is intense, intellectually challenging work. It won’t be for everyone, but it may be **exactly the challenge you’re looking for.**


**As a Forward\-Deployed Engineer, You Will**
---------------------------------------------


### **Find the Problem Worth Solving**


Work directly with customers to navigate ambiguity, uncover high\-value opportunities, challenge assumptions, and translate complex business needs into clear technical direction. This requires curiosity and business acumen as you discover business workflows and jointly define the outcomes an AI solution should drive.


### **Build Beyond the Frontier**


Architect and build production AI systems, from multi\-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, context engineering, memory and state, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) to the APIs, data pipelines, integrations, and distributed systems that make them reliable at scale.


### **Own the Outcome**


You won’t simply be given a list of responsibilities—you’ll have the authority to own the outcome for your client and make a real\-world impact through your work. You’ll lead solutions from discovery through deployment and measurable impact while staying hands\-on and owning evaluation, observability, security, reliability, latency, scalability, and cost.


**The Anti\-Sell**
------------------


**High ownership and intensity:** This role requires exceptional ownership and accountability. You’ll work with clients who have uncompromising expectations for quality, making this a demanding environment—and an ideal proving ground for people who seek difficult, high\-impact challenges.


**Client\-first and hybrid:** This role is based in Bengaluru or Hyderabad and requires working from the office three days per week. Candidates must currently be based in one of these two cities. Relocation assistance is not available.


**You’ll help write the playbook:** Enterprise AI operates like a startup. You may not always have an established process or playbook because you’ll be expected to apply your expertise, judgment, and technical depth to create one.


**Our Forward\-Deployed Engineers Typically Have**
--------------------------------------------------


**Deep production engineering experience:** Typically 8\+ years building and operating sophisticated software systems, with expertise in Python, backend systems, APIs, databases, distributed systems, system design, and cloud infrastructure.


**Hands\-on agentic AI experience:** Experience building production LLM and agent systems using orchestration, tool use, context engineering, memory and state, retrieval, and multistep workflows.


**Strong retrieval depth:** Experience building and improving production retrieval systems, with a practical understanding of embeddings, vector and hybrid search, reranking, evaluation, and diagnosing retrieval quality.


**End\-to\-end systems ownership:** A track record of taking complex systems from architecture through deployment and scale, with a practical understanding of evaluation, observability, reliability, security, guardrails, latency, scalability, and cost.


**Exceptional customer and technical leadership:** The ability to enter unfamiliar environments, earn trust quickly, navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions constructively, and communicate effectively with senior engineers and business executives.


**Client\-ready communication:** The ability to explain technical concepts clearly, navigate ambiguity, work with stakeholders, and remain calm under pressure.


**Values**
----------


* **We are client first:** We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
* **We work at Start\-Up Speed:** We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
* **We are AI forward:** We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

**About the Role**  
We're building a large\-scale, LinkedIn\-style professional networking platform (AssoXiate) with a comprehensive customer portal and admin panel spanning users, companies, jobs, marketplace, networking, stories/reels, and more. We're looking for a Backend Developer to join our engineering team and help build and scale our microservices architecture.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain backend microservices using NestJS
* Work with PostgreSQL (RDS), Redis, and OpenSearch to build performant, scalable data layers
* Develop and integrate REST APIs consumed by our Next.js web app and Flutter mobile app
* Implement queue\-based async workflows using BullMQ and RabbitMQ
* Collaborate on AWS infrastructure (ECS Fargate, S3, CloudFront) and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions → CodePipeline → ECR → ECS)
* Implement authentication, authorization, and RBAC (Casl.js)
* Integrate third\-party services: Stripe/Razorpay for payments, Firebase for push notifications, AI platforms (Gemini/OpenAI) for content workflows
* Write clean, tested, maintainable code and participate in code reviews
* Debug and optimize backend performance across microservices

**Requirements**

* Strong experience with Node.js and NestJS (or similar frameworks like Express)
* Solid understanding of PostgreSQL, Redis, and relational database design
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs
* Familiarity with AWS services (ECS, RDS, S3, CloudFront) or equivalent cloud platforms
* Experience with message queues (BullMQ, RabbitMQ, or similar)
* Understanding of microservices architecture
* Familiarity with Git\-based workflows and CI/CD pipelines
* Good problem\-solving skills and ability to work in a fast\-paced startup environment

Pay: ₹336,373\.57 \- ₹1,631,850\.33 per year

Work Location: In person
